CRITICAL FRONTEND BUG: BulkUtrDialog crashes React with runtime error 'Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {type, loc, msg, input, url})' as soon as a file is selected — validate POST fails with 422 because axios instance defaults to Content-Type: application/json (see /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js line 9) but /bulk-utr/validate expects multipart/form-data; FastAPI returns Pydantic error array which is then passed directly to sonner toast.error() and rendered as React children. ui_bugs.issue: Uploading a file triggers 'Uncaught runtime error: Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {type, loc, msg, input, url})'. Root cause: `api.post('/accounts/payment-queue/bulk-utr/validate', fd)` in BulkUtrDialog.jsx (lines 36, 51) uses the shared axios instance from /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js which sets default header `Content-Type: application/json`. When axios sees an existing Content-Type it does NOT override to multipart/form-data, so FastAPI receives an application/json request without a body field named 'file', returning HTTP 422 with `detail=[{type,loc,msg,input,url}]`. The catch handler does `toast.error(e.response?.data?.detail || 'Validation failed')` which passes the array directly to sonner and sonner attempts to render Pydantic error dicts as JSX children → runtime crash. Fix: either pass `{ headers: { 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' } }` (or `{'Content-Type': undefined}` and let axios auto-detect) on the two FormData posts, and/or route the detail through `formatApiErrorDetail()` already exported by api.js.

BulkUtrDialog button (ppc-bulk-utr-btn) is rendered inside the 'Verified / Bank File' tab (TabsContent value='verified', line 379) but the task specifies it should live on the 'Bank Files & Mark Paid' tab (TabsContent value='bank'). Currently ppc-tab-bank shows the button as NOT visible while ppc-tab-verified shows it. Backend accepts both stages so functionality is unaffected — placement only.

For a fully-approved & bill-generated request whose approval chain has 4 steps, the approval trail header renders 'Step 5 of 4' (current_step is incremented past end after Director approval). Minor cosmetic — expected 'Step 4 of 4'. See /app/frontend/src/components/BillRequestViewDialog.jsx around line 84.

integration_issues.issue: Wrong Content-Type header sent by axios shared instance causes 422 + React render crash; completely blocks UI flow. Backend endpoints are correct (verified via pytest with requests multipart).

action_items: FIX (critical): In /app/frontend/src/components/BulkUtrDialog.jsx, override Content-Type for the two multipart POSTs. Simplest: `api.post(url, fd, { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' } })` for both validate and apply. Also route the error into formatApiErrorDetail() so a Pydantic 422 array never reaches sonner as a raw object.
FIX (medium): Move `<BulkUtrDialog onDone={load} />` from line 379 (inside <TabsContent value="verified">) to inside <TabsContent value="bank"> to match the task spec ('Bank Files & Mark Paid' tab).
FIX (low, optional): Clamp the 'Step N of M' display in BillRequestViewDialog to `Math.min(current_step+1, chain.length)` so a completed 4-step chain shows 'Step 4 of 4' instead of 'Step 5 of 4'.
critical_code_review_comments: api.js line 9 hard-codes `Content-Type: application/json` on the shared axios instance. Any FormData upload through this client will silently fail with 422 unless the call site explicitly overrides the header. This has now bitten BulkUtrDialog. Consider dropping the global default and letting axios pick per-request (it already sets application/json for JSON payloads automatically), or add a `apiForm` helper wrapper that clears the header.

BulkUtrDialog.jsx catches error and does `toast.error(e.response?.data?.detail || …)` — this pattern must always go through formatApiErrorDetail() (already exported from api.js) otherwise a 422 detail array crashes React. Same anti-pattern likely exists elsewhere; consider a global sonner-safe helper.

BulkUtrDialog is placed under `<TabsContent value="verified">` in PaymentProcessingCenter.jsx while the tab is labelled 'Verified / Bank File'. Spec says it belongs under 'Bank Files & Mark Paid' — either move the component or rename the tab. The DB stages 'verified' and 'in_bank_file' both feed the template so functionality is unaffected.
BillRequestViewDialog approval header uses `current_step + 1` without clamping to chain length — a completed workflow prints 'Step 5 of 4'.

BillRequestViewDialog fetches on every open but has no cleanup / abort — if the user opens then rapidly closes/reopens with a different id, the older /full response can overwrite the newer state. Minor race condition; guard with a cancel token or effect ref.

rca of the issue: BulkUtrDialog frontend crash — chain of events: (1) User picks file; (2) BulkUtrDialog calls `api.post('/accounts/payment-queue/bulk-utr/validate', fd)`; (3) shared axios instance in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js has `headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }` default so the multipart request is mis-labelled; (4) FastAPI cannot parse the `file` UploadFile field and returns 422 with body `{ detail: [{type, loc: ['body','file'], msg, input, url}] }`; (5) the catch handler `toast.error(e.response?.data?.detail || 'Validation failed')` passes the array-of-objects directly to sonner; (6) sonner renders detail as React children → 'Objects are not valid as a React child' crash. Mitigation: force multipart header on the two FormData posts in BulkUtrDialog.jsx and always wrap error details in formatApiErrorDetail().
